name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.LenPre.stable
typeText:
∀ {V : List.{0} Nat},
  (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → And (LE.le.{0} 5 x) (LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN)) →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 7 ∉ V →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 8 ∉ V →
        ∀ {m m₁ : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m₁ V →
            DisequalityDispersion.Machine.LenPre m →
              And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.LenPre m₁)
                (And (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 7)) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 7)))
                  (And (Eq.{1} (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 8)) (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 8)))
                    (And
                      (Eq.{1} (m₁ (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 7)))
                        (m (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 7))))
                      (Eq.{1} (m₁ (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 8)))
                        (m (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 8)))))))

source.code:
theorem LenPre.stable {V : List ℕ} (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → 5 ≤ x ∧ x < IN) (h7 : G_ 7 ∉ V) (h8 : G_ 8 ∉ V)
    {m m₁ : Mem} (hag : Agree m m₁ V) (h : LenPre m) :
    LenPre m₁ ∧ m₁ (G_ 7) = m (G_ 7) ∧ m₁ (G_ 8) = m (G_ 8) ∧ m₁ (m (G_ 7)) = m (m (G_ 7)) ∧
      m₁ (m (G_ 8)) = m (m (G_ 8)) := by
  obtain ⟨hctx, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  have hhp : 200 ≤ m HP := hctx.2.2
  have hV' : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN := fun x hx => (hV x hx).2
  have hG7 : m₁ (G_ 7) = m (G_ 7) := hag.var (G_ 7) (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) h7
  have hG8 : m₁ (G_ 8) = m (G_ 8) := hag.var (G_ 8) (lt_hp hhp (by decide)) (by decide) h8
  refine ⟨⟨Ctx.of_agree hctx hag (fun x hx => (hV x hx).1), by rw [hG7]; exact h1,
    by rw [hG7]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h2 hag.2, by rw [hG8]; exact h3, by rw [hG8]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h4 hag.2⟩,
    hG7, hG8, hag.heap hV' _ h1 h2, hag.heap hV' _ h3 h4⟩
